related_issues.reason: Same ABI-tag wheel-availability hint family in the error output (musllinux tag missing from the hint), but a different cause and request; not the lock-time incomplete-wheel-set problem.

rationale: The reporter labels this a bug, but uv locked the wheel set the PyPI index showed at resolve time, which is the designed behaviour; the staggered per-platform uploads are a publish-timing state, not a uv defect or a non-standard registry. The reporter's own proposed fix is a new warning when a version's wheel set shrinks versus the previous release, which is a change request, so enhancement. The existing required-environments setting (docs/concepts/resolution.md, Required environments) already makes uv fail or require wheels for declared platforms, which the reporter found and which is the documented guard, so a maintainer could also read this as a question; that is the main alternative (medium confidence). Duplicate search for the lock-time incomplete-wheel problem returned no matches. Issue #14885, which the reporter cites, is about installs during a running uv and was not returned by my searches, so I did not list it. Reproduction is timing-dependent on upstream uploads, but the report includes the command, the error, the version and PyPI upload timestamps, so no MRE is needed.
